editorial:
Step into a hospital where every shift feels like a race against time, and you will meet Margot, a young intern trying to survive the country’s toughest ER. Just when the pressure seems impossible, patients her age start showing strange symptoms, and her own body begins changing in scary ways. This sci-fi horror keeps you on edge by mixing real-world medical stress with body horror, so the danger feels close and personal. You are not just watching monsters; you are watching someone lose control of herself while trying to save others.

The acting sells the fear, especially when Margot fights through panic and confusion. The pacing moves fast, with sharp scares and tense hospital scenes, though some story beats feel rushed near the end. If you like medical thrillers mixed with creature horror, this is a strong pick. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Margot discovers the strange illness is tied to an alien signal spreading through the hospital, and her transformations are part of a larger plan. She uses her medical knowledge to stop the outbreak, but the twist reveals she cannot fully reverse her own changes. She survives and keeps working in the ER, now hiding her new abilities while quietly protecting patients from the next wave.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves medical thrillers with body horror.
